eyebrow: Gym bora · run a better gym

slides.h: Wanachama wa Dar hawarudi kwa ajili ya mashine.
slides.en: Dar members don’t come back for the machines.
A greeting at the door. By name after week one. Nobody trains hard where they feel like a stranger.
A fan that works, water that runs, light when TANESCO lets you down. Members remember the gym that was ready.
A clean floor, a hook for the bag, a mirror that isn’t cracked. That is what they describe to a friend.
M-Pesa or Airtel Money at the desk, receipt on the phone. Not “come back tomorrow with cash”.
Without being asked, without selling a package. That is the staff members talk about.
FitFlex scores every gym on all of this before it joins. Not just the weights.
